verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that sandboxes can boot from Vercel Managed Images, shared or public images, or your own OCI/Docker images stored in Vercel Container Registry. Developers can build system packages and tooling into an image and share it across projects and teams, and snapshots act as reusable pre-configured starting points. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of custom-image workflows, and detail on the image build and registry push process.
